collection.description: A child asks whether two elderly women who spend every evening together are best friends or sweethearts.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: Two elderly women begin spending every evening together. A curious child asks whether they are best friends or sweethearts.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: One jokes that after sixty years she still gets nervous holding hands.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The child learns that not every relationship requires a public explanation.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: They smile and say they are both; the child decides that sounds lovely.
